w_gatebreaker.name: Gatebreaker
w_gatebreaker.text: +2 Might. Begin each fight with 6 Block.

w_prism_rod.name: Prism Rod
w_prism_rod.text: Begin with 3 Focus; draw 1 more on the first round.

w_philosophers_still.name: Philosopher's Still
w_philosophers_still.text: Begin with 2 Focus, Regen 3; draw 1 more on the first round.

w_seers_lens.name: Seer's Lens
w_seers_lens.text: Begin with 2 Ward; draw 1 more on the first round.

w_astrolabe.name: Drowned Astrolabe
w_astrolabe.text: Begin with 3 Ward; the company has +1 vigour on the first round.

w_witch_skull.name: Witch's Skull
w_witch_skull.text: +2 Might, 2 Ward; draw 1 more on the first round.

a_shroud.name: Shroud of the Drowned
a_shroud.text: +4 max HP; 25% less stress; Dodge on the first round.

t_candle_stub.name: Candle Stub
t_candle_stub.text: Draw 1 more on the first round.

t_kings_ring.name: Drowned King's Ring
t_kings_ring.text: +2 Might; the company has +1 vigour on the first round.

r_eye.name: Rune of the Eye
r_eye.text: +1 Focus at the start of each fight.

r_ward.name: Rune of Warding
r_ward.text: +1 Ward at the start of each fight.

r_thorn.name: Rune of Thorns
r_thorn.text: +2 Thorns at the start of each fight.

r_haste.name: Rune of Haste
r_haste.text: +1 Momentum at the start of each fight.

rl_bell_clapper.name: Bell Clapper
rl_bell_clapper.text: The company has +1 vigour on the first round of each fight.

rl_saints_finger.name: Saint's Finger
rl_saints_finger.text: Every hero begins each fight with 5 Block.

rl_drowned_lantern.name: Drowned Lantern
rl_drowned_lantern.text: Every hero begins each fight with 2 Ward.

rl_salt_crown.name: Crown of Salt
rl_salt_crown.text: Every hero sheds 3 stress at the start of each round.

rl_hooked_heart.name: Hooked Heart
rl_hooked_heart.text: Every hero heals 1 at the start of each round.

rl_kraken_beak.name: Kraken's Beak
rl_kraken_beak.text: Every hero begins each fight with 1 Might.

rl_tidestone.name: Tidestone
rl_tidestone.text: Every hero begins each fight with 2 Focus.

rl_reliquary.name: Reliquary of Bones
rl_reliquary.text: Every hero begins each fight with 3 Thorns.

rl_hourglass.name: Cracked Hourglass
rl_hourglass.text: Every hero draws 1 more card on the first round.

rl_black_pearl.name: Black Pearl
rl_black_pearl.text: Every hero begins each fight with Regen 2.

rl_anchor_link.name: Anchor Link
rl_anchor_link.text: Every hero begins each fight with 1 Armor for that fight.

rl_eel_skin.name: Eel-skin Gloves
rl_eel_skin.text: Every hero begins each fight with 1 Momentum.

festering.name: Festering Wound

studied.name: Studied
studied.text: +1 Focus at the start of each fight.

quick.name: Quick Hands
quick.text: Draw 1 more card on the first round.

cull.name: Cull the Deck
cull.text: Remove a card from this hero's deck.

ironwarden: Apply 1 Frost to the front foe at the start of each fight.
4 Block, and 1 Frost to every foe.
executioner: Mark the front foe at the start of each fight.
bloodletter: 2 Bleed on the front foe at the start of each fight.
accumulator: +2 Focus; Conjunctions may grow 4 stronger again.
prismatic: The front foe starts bearing one of every element.
plaguewright: 1 Toxin on every foe at the start of each fight.

events.title: A Drowned Chapel
events.text: Candles still burn under the water in a side chapel. A saint's reliquary sits on the altar, chained shut. Something knocks from inside it.

options.label: Break the chains (2 Tools)
options.after: The knocking stops. Inside: a relic, and a smell you will not forget.

options.label: Pray at the altar
options.after: A moment of quiet. The water outside grows darker.

options.label: Leave it be
options.after: Some doors are shut for a reason.

events.title: The Pilgrim's Corpse
events.text: A pilgrim lies face-down in the silt, pack still on his back. His hand is closed around something.

options.label: Search the pack
options.after: Hard bread, a purse, and a letter you choose not to read.

options.label: Pry open his hand
options.after: The fingers break as you open them. He was holding it very tightly.

options.label: Give him rites
options.after: The company feels a little less alone.

events.title: An Eel Nest
events.text: The passage narrows to a pool thick with eels. On the far side, a glint of gold.

options.label: Wade through
options.after: They bite. You keep walking. The gold is real.

options.label: Burn them out (1 Light)
options.after: Oil, fire, screaming water.

options.label: Find another way
options.after: It costs you time.

events.title: The Singing Well
events.text: A well in the floor of the nave. Voices rise out of it, singing your names.

options.label: Answer them
options.after: You learn something no one should know.

options.label: Drop a coin in (25 gold)
options.after: The song changes. A gift drifts up on the water.

options.label: Seal it with stones (1 Tools)
options.after: The singing stops. Mostly.

events.title: A Flooded Armoury
events.text: Racks of weapons and harness, half sunk in brine. Most of it is rust. Not all of it.

options.label: Dive for the good pieces
options.after: Cold, sharp edges in the dark. Worth it.

options.label: Salvage what's dry (1 Tools)
options.after: Careful work pays.

events.title: The Abbess's Confessional
events.text: A confessional booth. Behind the grille, a woman's voice offers absolution, for a price.

options.label: Confess (lose 6 max HP, one hero)
options.after: Something is taken. Something heavier is lifted.

options.label: Buy an indulgence (40 gold)
options.after: Coins slide through the grille. The voice laughs.

options.label: Curse her
options.after: She curses you back. She also drops her purse.

events.title: A Survivor
events.text: A starving man in a dry alcove begs for food. His eyes keep going to your throats.

options.label: Share food (2 Food)
options.after: He presses something into your hand before you go.

options.label: Put him out of his misery
options.after: Mercy, of a kind.

options.label: Walk away
options.after: His begging follows you a long way.

events.title: Tide Shrine
events.text: A shrine to a sea-saint, its offering bowl brimming with black water.

options.label: Drink from the bowl
options.after: It heals. It also stays with you.

options.label: Leave an offering (1 Medicine)
options.after: The water stills. You feel steadier.

events.title: A Collapsed Stair
events.text: The way down is choked with rubble. You can dig, or you can find another way in the dark.

options.label: Dig through (1 Tools)
options.after: Hard work, but quick.

options.label: Squeeze through the gap
options.after: Scraped, bruised, through.

options.label: Take the long way
options.after: Hours lost in the dark.

events.title: The Corpse Cart
events.text: An overturned cart of the drowned, bound for a burial that never came. One of them is still moving.

options.label: End it
options.after: It was not the only one moving.

options.label: Loot the cart
options.after: Rings, teeth, buttons. You do not look at the faces.

events.title: The Lantern Keeper
events.text: An old woman tends lanterns on a sunken pier. She trades light for stories, or for blood.

options.label: Tell her a story
options.after: She likes the sad ones best.

options.label: Give her blood
options.after: She drinks it from a lantern glass.

options.label: Buy oil (30 gold)
options.after: A fair trade, for once.

events.title: The Bone Scribe
events.text: A skeleton at a writing desk, quill still in hand. The page is half written. It is about you.

options.label: Read it
options.after: It knows how this ends.

options.label: Finish it yourself
options.after: You write a better ending. Something in your deck goes quiet.

options.label: Burn it (1 Light)
options.after: The water seems to recede, a little.

events.title: The Frozen Scout
events.text: A scout froze mid-stride on the ice, pack still on her back. The ice around her feet is hot to the touch.

options.label: Chip her free (1 Tools)
options.after: Her gear is good. Her face does not thaw.

options.label: Take the pack and run
options.after: The ice cracks behind you. Steam scalds your heels.

options.label: Leave her standing
options.after: Someone has to keep watch.

events.title: The Steam Vent
events.text: A vent breathes warm air through the glacier. The company could rest here, if the ground holds.

options.label: Rest by the vent
options.after: Warm for the first time in days.

options.label: Cook a meal over it (2 Food)
options.after: Hot food. Someone laughs.

events.title: The Abandoned Anvil
events.text: An anvil still glows on a silent line. A half-forged blade lies across it.

options.label: Finish the blade (1 Tools)
options.after: The hammer strikes true. The foundry answers, far away.

options.label: Quench your hands in the trough
options.after: It hurts. It also wakes you up.

events.title: The Storm Jar
events.text: A glass jar the height of a man holds a captured storm. It hums in your teeth.

options.label: Smash it
options.after: Lightning goes through all of you. Some of it stays.

options.label: Sell the copper fittings
options.after: It takes time to strip it properly.

events.title: A Lingering Guest
events.text: A bather still sits in a pool that has been boiling for a century. He beckons you in.

options.label: Join him
options.after: He gives you the ring off his finger. The finger comes with it.

options.label: Rob his clothes on the bench
options.after: He watches you do it. He does not stop smiling.

events.title: The Linen Store
events.text: Clean linen, folded and dry, in a cupboard the steam never reached.

options.label: Take bandages
options.after: Clean cloth is worth more than gold down here.

options.label: Rest among the linen
options.after: It smells of soap. Of before.

options.label: Search the back
options.after: Something was hiding back there. It left this behind.

events.title: The Last Canary
events.text: A canary in a cage, still alive, still singing. The gas has not reached it yet.

options.label: Carry it with you
options.after: It sings when the air turns. You learn to listen.

options.label: Let it go
options.after: It flies up the shaft. Someone has to get out.

options.label: Eat it
options.after: Nobody speaks for a while.

events.title: A Powder Cache
events.text: Kegs of blasting powder, dry, stacked by a collapsed tunnel.

options.label: Blast the tunnel (1 Light)
options.after: The seam behind it glitters.

options.label: Pack some for later
options.after: One of you learns a dangerous trick.

events.title: The Unburnt Hand
events.text: In a heap of ash, one hand has not burned. It still holds a rosary.

options.label: Take the rosary
options.after: The hand lets go. It should not have been able to.

options.label: Bury the hand
options.after: The black fire flickers, as if insulted.

events.title: The Confession Fire
events.text: A brazier of black flame. A sign reads: SPEAK YOUR SIN AND BE LIGHTER.

options.label: Confess (one hero)
options.after: The fire takes the sin, and a little of the sinner.

options.label: Feed it a card
options.after: Something you knew burns away.

options.label: Douse it (1 Medicine)
options.after: It hisses out. You learn what it was guarding.

events.title: The Stopped Clock
events.text: A clock face in the wall. The hands are frozen at one minute to twelve. You could move them.

options.label: Wind it back
options.after: Time slips. Your heads ache.

options.label: Wind it forward
options.after: You see what comes next. It is worse.

options.label: Leave it at one minute to

events.title: The Star Chart
events.text: A chart of the frozen sky, annotated in a shaking hand.

options.label: Study it
options.after: The stars stopped here. You learn where.

options.label: Sell the brass frame
options.after: Heavy, but worth it.

options.label: Burn it for warmth (1 Light)
options.after: Warm hands are worth more than stars.

events.title: The Ship's Galley
events.text: A frozen galley, the stores still sealed in ice.

options.label: Chip out the stores (1 Tools)
options.after: Salt pork, hard tack, rum.

options.label: Drink the captain's rum
options.after: Courage, of a kind.

events.title: The Weeping Figurehead
events.text: A ship's figurehead, a woman carved in oak. She is crying real tears, and they freeze.

options.label: Collect the tears
options.after: Each tear is a frozen pearl.

options.label: Speak to her
options.after: She tells you how the fleet died.

events.title: Grave Goods
events.text: A side tomb, unopened. The seal is old and the cold has kept everything.

options.label: Open it (1 Tools)
options.after: Fine things, and a smell like old meat.

options.label: Leave an offering of food (1 Food)
options.after: The barrow seems to settle.

events.title: The Barrow Physician
events.text: A dead physician in a beaked mask, still holding a bag of cures.

options.label: Take the bag
options.after: The cures are real. So is what was on them.

options.label: Read his notes
options.after: He understood the plague. It did not help him.

events.title: A Frozen Campfire
events.text: A campfire, still burning, frozen in ice. The flames do not move.

options.label: Thaw it (1 Light)
options.after: It burns again. Nobody talks.

options.label: Take the frozen flame
options.after: It is cold in the hand.

events.title: The Listening Stone
events.text: A standing stone with an ear carved in it. The silence here is complete.

options.label: Whisper a secret
options.after: The stone keeps it.

options.label: Shout
options.after: Something heard.

options.label: Keep silent
options.after: You learn to listen.

events.title: A Wreck's Hold
events.text: The hold of a ship the wreckers brought in. The cargo is still aboard.

options.label: Haul the cargo
options.after: Silk, spice, a box of teeth.

options.label: Free the survivor in the brig
options.after: A sailor, half drowned, grateful. She gives you her lucky charm.

events.title: The Lightning Rod
events.text: An iron rod on the cliff, black with strikes. A storm is coming.

options.label: Stand beneath it
options.after: It strikes. One of you learns something.

options.label: Take shelter
options.after: The storm passes over.

events.title: A Honey Cell
events.text: A cell of dark honey, crackling with static.

options.label: Eat it
options.after: Sweet. Then numb. Then sweet again.

options.label: Jar it (1 Tools)
options.after: It keeps wounds clean.

events.title: The Cocooned Knight
events.text: A knight wrapped in silk, still breathing. His sword hangs outside the cocoon.

options.label: Cut him free
options.after: He is not a knight any more.

options.label: Take the sword
options.after: He sighs as you go.

options.label: Leave him
options.after: He is still breathing when you leave.

events.title: A Fallen Feather
events.text: An angel's feather as long as a spear, lying in the ruins.

options.label: Take it
options.after: It is warm. It hums when lightning is near.

options.label: Pray over it
options.after: Nobody answers. It still helps.

events.title: The Edge of the Rift
events.text: The ruins end at a tear in the sky. Something on the other side is looking at you.

options.label: Look back
options.after: You see it. It sees you. You both learn something.

options.label: Throw something in (25 gold)
options.after: Something comes back out.

events.title: The Hag's Kettle
events.text: A kettle bubbling on a stilt-hut porch. The hag is away.

options.label: Drink the brew
options.after: It heals. It tastes of the bog.

options.label: Steal the kettle's contents
options.after: She will know.

events.title: The Bog Offering
events.text: A bog body with a gold torc around its neck. It has been there a thousand years.

options.label: Take the torc
options.after: It was not done being an offering.

options.label: Add an offering (1 Food)
options.after: The fen seems to sigh.

events.title: The Fairy Ring
events.text: A perfect ring of pale mushrooms. The air inside is still and sweet.

options.label: Step inside
options.after: You lose an hour. Maybe more.

options.label: Pick the mushrooms
options.after: Edible. Mostly.

events.title: The Gardener's Journal
events.text: A journal left on a bench. The handwriting gets worse as it goes.

options.label: Read it
options.after: By the end it is not his handwriting.

options.label: Tear out the last page
options.after: Some things should not be learned.

boss.name: Slay the Drowned King
boss.text: Reach the throne and kill the King.

relic.name: Recover the Pearl of Saint Ysolde
relic.text: A relic-keeper elite guards the Pearl deep in the kingdom. Take it and survive the boss.

purge.name: Purge the Belfry
purge.text: Win six fights before facing the boss.

escort.name: Escort the Pilgrim
escort.text: A pilgrim walks with you. Each time a hero falls to Death's Door, the pilgrim loses heart. Reach the boss with the pilgrim alive.

ascension.name: Rising Water
ascension.text: The doom clock advances twice as fast.

ascension.name: Haunted Company
ascension.text: Heroes begin the run with 25 stress.

ascension.name: Meagre Spoils
ascension.text: Card rewards offer two choices, not three.

ascension.name: No Rest
ascension.text: Field camps heal half as much.

ascension.name: Marked by the Deep
ascension.text: Every hero begins the run with a Dread curse.

ascension.name: Brittle Bones
ascension.text: Death's Door always leaves an injury, and Grit is 1 lower.

ascension.name: The Deep Remembers
ascension.text: Foes grow stronger with doom twice as fast.

provisioner.name: Provisioner
provisioner.text: +2 Food at the start of each run.

lamplighter.name: Lamplighter
lamplighter.text: +2 Light at the start of each run.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.text: +40 gold at the start of each run.

surgeon.name: Surgeon
surgeon.text: +1 Medicine at the start of each run.

armourer.name: Armourer
armourer.text: Every hero starts the run with a common armour.

veterans.name: Veterans
veterans.text: Heroes start the run at level 2.
